paite: Rakil in Jakob ta himhim aneihsak kei chih akitheih in asanggamnu ahazata hi. Jakob kiang ah, "Tate hon pia in, huchi ahihkeileh ka si ding," achi hi.
english: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

paite: Rakil tung ah Jakob aheh a, "Gilgah hon pe lou Pathian bang ka hi a hia?" achi hi.
english: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

paite: Ama'n, "En in, ka sikhanu Bilhah kithuahpih in. Huchi a ke'n leng amah a kipan tate ka neih sam theihna ding in ka phei tung ah ta ka hon nei ding hi," achi hi.
english: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

paite: Huan azi ding in asikhanu Bilhah apia a, Jakob in amah ana kithuahpih hi.
english: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

paite: Bilhah agai a, Jakob ta aneihsakta hi.
english: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

paite: Rakil in, "Pathian in hon ngaihtuah a, ka aw leng aza, tapa ahon pia,” achi hi. Huaiziak in amin Dan asa hi.
english: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.

paite: Rakil sikhanu Bilhah agai nawn a, Jakob tapa dang aneihsak nawn hi.
english: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

paite: Rakil in, "Nakpitak in ka sanggamnu ka buan a, ka zouta," achi a; amin Naphtali asa hi.
english: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.

paite: Leah in ta dang anei nawn kei chih akitheih in, asikhanu Zilpah api a, azi ding in Jakob kiang ah apia hi.
english: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

paite: Huan Leah sikhanu Zilpah in Jakob tapa aneihsak hi.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.

paite: Leah in, "Vangphathuai ei," achi a; amin Gad asa hi.
english: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

paite: Leah sikhanu Zilpah in Jakob tapa dang aneihsak nawn hi.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.

paite: Leah in, "Hampha hi na tel ing e! Numeite'n hampha hon chi ding uh ei ve," achi a, amin Asher asa hi.
english: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.

paite: Buh lak hun lai in Reuben in gamlak ah zawl-ai ava mu a; anu Leah kiang ah hon tawi hi. Rakil in Leah kiang ah, "Hehpih in na tapa zawl-ai akhen hon pe dih ve," achi hi.
english: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka pasal na hon suhsak thil namai ahi hia? Ka tapa zawl-ai leng hon suhsak na tum nawn lai maw?" achi hi. Rakil in, "Na tapa' zawl-ai sik in tuzan nang ahon kithuahpih ding," achi hi.
english: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”

paite: Nitaklam in Jakob gamlak a kipan ahong tung a, adawn ding in Leah akuan a, "N'on kithuahpih ding ahi. Ka tapa zawl-ai in ka hon guaita ngal a," achi hi. Huai zan in amah akithuahpih hi.
english: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.

paite: Pathian in Leah thumna angaikhia a, agai a, Jakob tapa ngana aneihsak nawn hi.
english: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

paite: Leah in, “Ka sikhanu ka pasal kiang a ka piak ziak in Pathian in ka loh hon pia ei ve,” achi a; amin Issakar asa hi.
english: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

paite: Leah agai nawn a, Jakob tapa gukna aneihsak nawn hi.
english: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

paite: Leah in, "Pathian in thil hoihtak hon neisak a; tu in zaw ka pasal tapa guk ka neihsak tak ziak in, ka kiang ah atengta ding," achi a; amin Zebulun asa hi.
english: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

paite: Huai nung in tanu anei nawn a, amin Dinah asa hi.
english: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.

paite: Pathian in Rakil atheigige a, Pathian in athumna angaikhia a, asul ahonsak hi.
english: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

paite: Amah agai a, tapa anei a, "Pathian in ka minsia alamangta," achi hi.
english: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

paite: "TOUPA'N tapa dang hon piakbeh ding," chi in amin Joseph asa hi.
english: She named him Joseph, saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Rakil in Joseph aneih nung in, Jakob in Laban kiang ah, "Kei ka omna ngei ah, ka gam ah hon paisakta in.
heading: Laban Kiang A Jakob Thilnget
english: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

paite: Na nna ka sepsan ka zite leh ka tate hon pia inla, hon paisak in; na nna ka hon sepsakdan lah na thei ngal a,” achi hi.
english: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”

paite: Laban in akiang ah, "Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh hehpih in om tadih lai ve. nang vang in TOUPA'N kei ahon vualzawl, chih ka thiltuahte a kipan in ka sinkhia hi,” achi hi.
english: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.”

paite: Amah mah in, “Na thaman ding gen inla, hon hilh dih, ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Bangchi in na nna ka sem a, bangchi in ka kiang ah na gantate a-om ua, na thei akei hiam?
english: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.

paite: Ka hong ma in tawmchik kia na nei a, tu'n zaw tampi ahong phata uh. Ka kalsuanna peuh ah TOUPA'N nang hon vualzawl hi. Himahleh chikchiang in ahia ka inkuante a ding a ka sepkhiak sam ding?" achi hi.
english: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

paite: Ama'n, "Bang ka hon pe dia?" achi a. Jakob in, "Bangmah na hon piak ding ahi kei. Hiai thil na hon hihsakleh na gantate ka khah dia ka ching nawn ding hi.
english: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.

paite: Tuni in na gantate ka va enkhe vek ding a, belam lak a, avom gial petmah a gial leh avom a gial zekzek leh avom peuhmah, kel lak a, akang a gial petmah agial leh akang a gial zekzekte huai a kipan ka pituam zel ding hi. Tuban huchibang a hong piang peuhmah ka loh ahita ding hi.
english: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

paite: Tunung a nang toh kal a ka thaman en ding a na hong pai hun chiang in, ka diktatna in ahon dawng mai ding. Kel lak a akang a gial petmah a gial lou leh akang a gial zekzek lou leh belam lak a avom lou ka kiang a na muh peuhmah ka guk in na sep mai ding," achi hi.
english: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”

paite: Laban in, "Ngai in, na gen bang geih in hi hen aw," achi hi.
english: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

paite: Huai nitak in keltal akang a gial leh akang a gial zekzek teng leh kelnu akang gial petmah a gial leh akang a gial zekzek teng akanna om peuhmah, belam lak a avom tengteng toh apituam a, atapate khut ah apia hi.
english: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

paite: Amah leh Jakob kikal ah ni thum lam a-omsak a; Jakob in Laban ganhon dangte aching nawn hi.
english: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

paite: Jakob in hiangzau sing leh makha sing leh sesing chiang hing ala a, ahawng akhokngou chiat a, chiangte ah angoute akilangsak hi.
english: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

paite: Achiang hawng khohte ganhonte'n tui ahong dawnna zel tuikuangte ah, tui luannate ah leh gantate mazawn zel ah akoih hi; tui dawn ding a ahong pai chiang ua againa ding un.
english: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

paite: Gantate chiangte ma ah agai panta ua, agialte, gial petmah a gialte, agial zekzekte hon neikhia uhi.
english: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

paite: Jakob in belamnoute akoihtuam a, ganhonte Laban ganhon lak a, agial leh avom tengteng lam angasak zel a; amah ganhonte akoihtuam zel a, Laban ganhon lak ah akoih kei hi.
english: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, gannu hatzawte ahuk chiang un, agaitheihna ding un Jakob in tuiluanna ah, ganhonte mitmuh in chiangte akoih zel hi.
english: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;

paite: Himahleh gannu hatloute mai ah akoih kei hi. Anou hatloute Laban a ahi ua, ahatte Jakob a ahi zel uhi.
english: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

paite: Jakob nakpi in ahong pung a, ganhon thupitak, sikhanute, sikhapate, sangawngsaute leh sabiltungte aneita hi.
english: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
